The closing allowance (+5) is generic and already applies to any counted agent. A Write to scratch/dispatch/other/critic-notes.md is admitted today after the cap, so the pin 'critic-notes.md outside scratch/dispatch/critic-*/ is refused' is genuinely red. The pattern must become critic-prefixed subdirs.
